title: Bonfire Fast Travel
description: Kindle bonfires across the world, connect them into a network, and travel between the flames whenever the journey grows long. Multiplayer Friendly!
body:
## 🔥 Bonfire Fast Travel 🔥
Kindle your own network of bonfires and travel between them whenever the path ahead grows long. Bonfire Fast Travel adds a simple, immersive fast-travel system inspired by souls-like games.
Each player owns their own bonfire network. Players can choose who is allowed to use their network, making it perfect for servers where you wouldnt want just anyone finding your stuff.

## Features

- Create and name bonfires anywhere in your world.
- Rename existing bonfires at any time.
- Automatic cleanup when campfires are removed.
- Bonfire networks are owned by individual players.
- Ownership prevents unauthorized editing.
- When enabled in the config there is a built-in permissions management menu for managing those allowed to use your network.
- Optional cross-dimension travel can be enabled via a config file.
- Compatible with Serilums healing campfire mod

## How To Use
### Creating a Bonfire
- Craft a Bonfire using a iron sword above a campfire.
- Sneak + Right Click with an empty hand.
- Enter a name and save.
### Renaming a Bonfire
- Sneak + Right Click your existing bonfire with an empty hand.
- Change the name and save.
- Only the owner of a bonfire can rename it.
### Traveling
- Right Click a registered bonfire with an empty hand.
- Select a destination from the menu.
- Travel instantly to another bonfire within the same dimension and network.
### Granting Access
- Set "permissionsEnabled": true, in the config file.
- Right Click an owned bonfire.
- Click on "Grant Kindling" a the top right.
- Type in your friends name and hit the "grant" button.

Feel free to use in your modpacks.
